name: MicroVQA
intro: MicroVQA 是面向生物显微研究的多模态推理基准，包含 1,042 道由生物学专家创建并全量复核的多项选择题，覆盖专家图像理解、假设生成和实验方案设计三类科学研究任务。
org: Stanford University; Tsinghua University; University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill; Princeton University; KTH Royal Institute of Technology; Chan Zuckerberg Biohub Network
build_method: 专家构建, 两阶段MCQ生成, 多智能体优化
task_type: 视觉问答, 科学问答
eval_feature: 研究级推理, 显微图像, 语言捷径控制
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Two-stage MCQ Generation, Multi-agent Refinement
eval_feature_en: Research-level Reasoning, Microscopy Images, Language-shortcut Control
intro_en: MicroVQA is a multimodal reasoning benchmark for biological microscopy research. It contains 1,042 multiple-choice questions created and fully reviewed by biology experts across expert image understanding, hypothesis generation, and experiment proposal.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2503.13399 Sections 3-5 and Appendices E-F. The diagrams preserve task definition through nine microscopy-research interviews; recruitment of 12 biology experts; licensed image sourcing from contributor experiments, databases, and papers since 2024; creation of 1,061 raw samples at 30-40 minutes each; quality feedback after the first 10 and 40 samples; 50 physician-scientist-authored NBME-aligned gold MCQs; DSPy prompt optimization using content, format, and clue metrics; Stage-one exam conversion; RefineBot evaluator-reflector, rewriter, and semantic checker; seed reruns requiring both GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 to fail twice; full original-creator review of the 1,042 released MCQs; and MMMU-Pro CoT accuracy evaluation with task and no-image analyses.
